title: Getting Started with the API
body:
This guide walks you through authenticating with our API and making your first request.

## Authentication

All API requests require a Bearer token in the Authorization header. Generate your API key from Settings > API Keys.

```
Authorization: Bearer your-api-key-here
```

## Making Your First Request

Use the /api/v1/me endpoint to verify your authentication:

```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer your-key' https://api.example.com/v1/me
```

## Rate Limits

Free plans: 100 requests/minute. Professional: 1,000/minute. Enterprise: Custom.

title: Setting Up Single Sign-On (SSO)
body:
Configure SAML-based SSO for your organization.

## Supported Providers

- Okta
- Azure AD
- Google Workspace
- OneLogin

## Configuration Steps

1. Navigate to Settings > Security > SSO
2. Select your identity provider
3. Enter your SSO URL and certificate
4. Configure attribute mapping
5. Test the connection
6. Enable SSO for your organization

## Troubleshooting

If you see a SAML validation error, verify that your IdP certificate hasn't expired and that the Assertion Consumer Service URL matches exactly.

title: Importing Data via CSV
body:
Import contacts, deals, and other records using CSV files.

## File Requirements

- UTF-8 encoding
- Maximum file size: 50MB
- Maximum 100,000 rows per import
- Headers must match field names exactly

## Steps

1. Go to Settings > Import/Export
2. Select the data type (contacts, deals, etc.)
3. Upload your CSV file
4. Map columns to fields
5. Preview and confirm

## Tips for Large Imports

For files over 10MB, consider splitting into multiple batches. The system processes imports asynchronously and will email you when complete.

title: Webhook Configuration Guide
body:
Set up webhooks to receive real-time notifications when events occur.

## Supported Events

- `order.created` — New order placed
- `order.updated` — Order status changed
- `contact.created` — New contact added
- `payment.received` — Payment processed

## Setup

1. Go to Settings > Webhooks
2. Click 'Add Webhook'
3. Enter your endpoint URL (must be HTTPS)
4. Select events to subscribe to
5. Save and test

## Security

All webhook payloads include an `X-Signature` header. Verify this against your webhook secret to ensure authenticity.

title: Understanding Your Invoice
body:
A breakdown of your monthly invoice line items.

## Line Items

- **Base Plan** — Your subscription tier (Starter, Professional, Enterprise)
- **Additional Users** — Per-seat charges above your plan's included seats
- **API Overage** — Charges for API calls exceeding your plan limit
- **Add-ons** — Optional features like premium support or custom domains

## Payment Methods

We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and ACH bank transfers (Enterprise only).

## Billing Cycle

Monthly plans bill on the 1st of each month. Annual plans bill on your subscription anniversary date.

title: Two-Factor Authentication Setup
body:
Secure your account with two-factor authentication (2FA).

## Methods

- **Authenticator App** (recommended) — Google Authenticator, Authy, or 1Password
- **SMS** — Text message codes to your phone

## Setup

1. Go to Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication
2. Choose your method
3. Scan the QR code or enter your phone number
4. Enter the verification code
5. Save your backup codes

## Lost Access?

If you lose access to your 2FA method, use a backup code to log in. If you've lost your backup codes, contact support with your account email and photo ID.

title: Batch Operations API (Draft)
body:
Documentation for the upcoming batch operations API.

## Endpoints

- `POST /api/v1/batch/create` — Create multiple records
- `POST /api/v1/batch/update` — Update multiple records
- `POST /api/v1/batch/delete` — Delete multiple records

## Limits

- Maximum 1,000 records per batch request
- Requests are processed asynchronously
- Status polling via `GET /api/v1/batch/:id/status`
